title: End-to-End Validation & Benchmarks
brief: Validate all activation claims end-to-end. Benchmark token reduction (target <=30% vs baseline). Benchmark cold-start recovery (target <=3 exchanges to productive state). Produce quantitative evidence for all MXU targets.

units.title: Validate activation claims: run each bundle, verify all declared capabilities are callable
Benchmark token reduction: compare baseline vs optimized workflows, verify <=30% reduction
Benchmark cold-start recovery: measure exchanges to productive state, verify <=3 target
Regression test suite: ensure no capability lost during MXU optimization
Produce validation report with quantitative evidence for all MXU targets
